title: Pokémon Species Treemap Dataset
description: A static species-level snapshot supporting the Otaku Data Viz Pokédex Type Treemap, including types, generations, base stats, evolution families, selected descriptive fields, and visualization-oriented presentation fields.

coverage.inclusionRule: One record for each species returned by the PokéAPI pokemon-species endpoint through National Pokédex number 1025; the default Pokémon variety supplies battle stats, abilities, moves, types, and artwork references.
exclusions: Alternate forms and non-default varieties are not separate species records.
Species introduced after National Pokédex number 1025 are outside this snapshot.

sources.name: PokéAPI v2
sources.role: Primary upstream source for species, default varieties, types, stats, abilities, moves, generations, localized names, flavor text, and evolution chains.
sources.retrieval: The repository generator requests pokemon-species, pokemon, and evolution-chain resources and stores a static snapshot.

sources.name: PokéAPI sprites repository
sources.role: Upstream host referenced by the artwork and sprite URL fields.
sources.retrieval: Image URLs are referenced; image binaries are not included in this dataset package.

methodology: Retrieve the configured species range from PokéAPI's pokemon-species endpoint.
Use each species' default variety to retrieve types, six base stats, abilities, move names, and artwork references.
Retrieve and flatten each unique evolution chain to assign family identifiers, family labels, stages, parents, and children.
Normalize machine names into display labels and select the most recent available English flavor-text entry.
Sort records by National Pokédex number and derive type, generation, and treemap aggregates.
Validate coverage, uniqueness, stats, relationships, aggregate counts, provenance metadata, and byte equality with the public site copy.

transformations.description: Hyphenated API identifiers are converted to title-style display labels.
Calculated as the sum of HP, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed.
Derived by flattening the upstream evolution-chain graph; large branching families use a compact root-based family label.
Newlines and form-feed characters are removed from the selected English flavor-text entry.
Calculated from species records for visualization loading and backwards compatibility.

modeledFields.description: Presentation-only values calculated from total base stats and list position. They are not official move power values.
Generic card-display copy written by the generator. It is not official move description text.
Uses the Pokémon's primary type for card presentation and does not assert the move's official type.

limitations: The snapshot ends at National Pokédex number 1025 and will not reflect later species until deliberately regenerated.
Only the default variety is used; alternate forms, regional forms, Mega Evolutions, Gigantamax forms, and other variants are not separate records.
Flavor text is a selected English entry rather than a complete version-by-version history.
The visualization groups species by primary type even though the compatibility treemap aggregate also contains secondary-type membership.
Move selection takes the first four upstream move references; it is not a ranking of signature, legal, current-generation, or competitively useful moves.
Modeled card-display power, type, and text fields must not be treated as official move data.
This fan-made dataset is not a substitute for official game resources or a competitive battle database.
verification: The canonical file must contain 1,025 unique, ordered National Pokédex records for this version.
Every baseStatsTotal must equal the sum of the six component stats.
Type counts, generation counts, evolution-family fields, and treemap group counts are recomputed during validation.
The canonical and public JSON files must be byte-for-byte identical.
Landing-page factual claims are checked against the canonical snapshot by the repository verifier.

reuse.note: Otaku Data Viz does not grant rights to Pokémon names, data, artwork references, or other third-party material. Review PokéAPI's project information, upstream terms, and applicable intellectual-property rights before reuse, redistribution, licensing, or commercial use.

citation: Otaku Data Viz, Pokémon Species Treemap Dataset, version 1.0.0, generated 2026-05-25 from PokéAPI data and reviewed 2026-08-10.
